reuse.why: Adds one guard used by all five provider link functions; it uses the db layer directly, the way the surrounding app.ts handlers do, though the tree's link.ts module holding the shared linking logic was not used.

duplication.why: The rule is a single query and check; each provider only adds a one-line call.

placement.why: The guard is a private function in accounts/app.ts next to its callers; link.ts, which already holds the shared linking helper findOrCreateBank, would be the more natural home.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five calls and a release note.

maintainability.why: Simple and in one place; no tests were added, and the call still has to be repeated in each of five copied provider functions (pre-existing structure).

bypasses_abstraction.where: No existing abstraction for this check is bypassed; all link handlers call assertNotLinkedElsewhere.

one_place.where: assertNotLinkedElsewhere in server/accounts/app.ts, called by all five provider link functions.
